crossRefs.note: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

people.name: Kedemoth
people.line: A town in Moab, later a Levitical city in Reuben

people.name: Mephaath
people.line: A Levitical city in Reuben, later Moabite

translations.web: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.
translations.bsb: Kedemoth, and Mephaath—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.asv: Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs; four cities.
